_comment: Hand-kept inputs to aggregate.mjs. `manual_usd` is a per-goal USD nudge for money no rail reports — prefer a ledger.json entry, which also earns the donor a card; use this only for lump sums with no donor attached. `founders` is prepended to the wall verbatim: aggregate.mjs REBUILDS manifest.supporters on every run, so a name that is not here and not in the ledger will not survive the next commit.
